answer: Agents bind identity to a hardware pulse signature, so each new node must stake capital proportional to its claimed fatigue threshold, preventing a sybil grove from blooming cheaply. A gossiped echo of every stake update lets peers cross-check limit-load telemetry against non-linear auction equilibria, flagging collusive clusters before they distort bids. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
